prompt: A volunteer on the clipboard waiting list arrives at ten ten without a clipboard. What should they expect?
promptZh: 一名排在寫字板候補名單上的志工十點十分抵達，沒帶寫字板。他可以期待什麼？

options.text: They can collect any booked clipboard as soon as they arrive.
options.zh: 一抵達就可以領走任何預約的寫字板。
options.whyZh: 預約的寫字板會保留到十點十五分。

options.text: They must bring their own clipboard because none are lent to people on the waiting list.
options.zh: 候補者借不到寫字板，必須自行準備。
options.whyZh: 候補者有機會領到預約逾時未領的寫字板。

options.text: They may receive a clipboard after ten fifteen if a booked one goes unclaimed.
options.zh: 十點十五分後若有預約未領的寫字板，就有機會領到。
options.whyZh: 候補者要等領取期限過後，而且是否領到取決於有無未領的寫字板。

options.text: They will receive a clipboard from the yard as soon as it stops raining.
options.zh: 雨停後就一定能在院子裡領到寫字板。
options.whyZh: 寫字板在接待櫃檯發放，且候補取決於未領數量，不是天氣。

evidence: If you booked a clipboard, pick it up at the welcome desk by ten fifteen. After that, we'll give unclaimed clipboards to volunteers on the waiting list.
explanationZh: 候補者要等領取期限過後，而且是否領到取決於有無未領的寫字板。
difficultyRationale: Apply the pickup priority and cutoff to a waiting-list arrival before the deadline; distinct from the late-arrival own-clipboard case.

vocabulary.note: 指已預訂但未被領走的物品，不是原本就沒有預訂。
